title: SMOK TFV18 Tank
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
SMOK continues to innovate, this time around it’s with the TFV18 Tank. With a 7.5ml e-liquid capacity, this tank is sure to produce big clouds & last you all day. It is compatible with SMOK’s TFV16 coils and the new TFV18 coils.
Accessory Quick Links:
SMOK TFV16 Replacement Coils
SMOK TFV18 Replacement Coils
Diameter: 32mm
Capacity: 7.5mL (Optional 6.5mL available)
Construction: Pyrex Glass and 304 Stainless Steel
Fill System: Press and Slide Top Fill
Coils: TFV18 Mesh Coil Series and TFV16 coil series
0.33ohm TFV18 Meshed Coils rated for 80-140W (Best at 100-110W)
0.15ohm TFV18 Dual Meshed Coils rated for 80-140W (Best at 100-110W)
Coil Installation: Press-Fit
Airflow Control: Dual Slotted Bottom Ring
Tank Connection: Threaded 510
1x TFV18 Tank
1x 0.33ohm TFV18 Meshed Coil
1x 0.15ohm TFV18 Dual Meshed Coil
1x Replacement Bulb Glass Tube
1x User Manual
